method: The #1811 registration method: createVortex seed 970 at 1000x700, 240 warm-up frames of the #1810 bench script (4 scripted marks/frame, wetAdvect 0.6), then 5 batches x 60 emit+step frames timed with performance.now; median of batch medians; two runs per variant per tree, same sandbox session back-to-back. Variants: absent (no tint), tinted (rgb on every mark, no scale — the #1811 session shape; pigment covers ~58% of the field), scaled (tinted + scaleX/scaleY 0.26 — the live contract's shape; the pre-#1876 build ignores scale, so its scaled run equals its tinted run). Frame = emit + step, the live loop's unit of work.

registered.decision: timeMs pin STANDS at 6.6 (the #1812 precedent: a same-session A/B delta of +~0.3 ms was recorded inside the figure). memoryBytes re-registered: 1507328 -> 1523712 (+16384, the wetWork byte plane), formula updated in vortex.mjs and its selfcheck pin.
registered.memoryFormula: 128*128*4*9 (grid planes) + 128*128*16*3 (pigment RGBA arrays) + 4096*16*2 (vorton ring + scratch) + 128*128 (wetWork byte plane)

verdict: Pigment-live delta vs base in one session: +0.25 to +0.45 ms/frame (tinted), +0.31 to +0.50 ms/frame (scaled). Pigment-absent unchanged (medians interleave with base). Sandbox numbers on a shared VM; absolute ms vary by day (the #1811 registration day measured 6.28-6.93 on this same bench); the same-session delta is the decision-grade figure. Device confirmation stays with the #1695 harness.
